CARD
**Still not ready**

The "show more" and "show less" buttons on long messages get a small icon before the text: an expand icon on "show more" and a collapse icon on "show less". Since the last feedback, the author changed the icon spacing and alignment in a new CSS file.

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ℹ️  | Three new commits and `web/styles/message_row.css` were added to fix the icon alignment. The first commit's size went from +2 to +9 lines. |
| ✅  | The alignment question was answered with a code push, and the author says the screenshots were updated. |
| ❌  | The alignment, formatting and "nudge by 1px" fixes are separate commits. They belong in the first commit, so the history should be one clean commit. |
| ⚠️  | Several self-review boxes are still unchecked: responsiveness and i18n, corner cases, and automated tests. |
| ℹ️  | CI status is unknown. |

**Reviewer:** @laurynmm — asked the alignment question and can confirm the screenshots once the commits are cleaned up.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" until the commits are squashed; then remove it, add "maintainer review", and assign @laurynmm.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the alignment fixes! Please squash the "Align", "Fix formatting via prettier" and "Nudge" commits into the first commit, following the [commit discipline guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/commit-discipline.html). Also finish the unchecked self-review items, or note why they don't apply.
```
